notes: Source accounts_fw is a fixed-width flat file (DELIMITED=NO): ACCT_NO bytes 0-5, HOLDER 6-15, BALANCE 16-24, OPENED 25-34 (PHYSICALOFFSET/PHYSICALLENGTH), no header (SKIPROWS 0).
Numbers keep their leading zeros and sign in the file: '000123' is 123, '-00050.25' is -50.25.
An all-blank date field is NULL; OPENED is a datetime in MM/DD/YYYY.
